byRootMessage.reason: String.replace replacement syntax: dollar-containing literals (including a lone dollar) and computed replacements are refused.

byRootMessage.reason: One WeakMap-dependent assignment; three locals absent after refused String.replace calls. Assignment consequences are not tagged cascade.
